text:
alex: Heads up — planning a staggered maintenance window for apac-gpu-pool (azap1) next Tue 02:00–05:00 UTC. We'll do NIC microcode + soft GPU reboots in 3 cohorts to avoid a full pool outage.
priya: What hit on available GPU capacity should teams expect? We have a partner demo Wed morning in APAC.
sam: Estimated impact: cohort sizes ~20% of the pool each. During each cohort's reboot we expect ~18% capacity loss for the region, but routing will shift some traffic to eu/apac-edge so global impact ~5–7%.
nina: Can we pre-warm prefix cache + KV so cold-starts don't spike latency for chat workloads?
alex: Yes — plan is to seed KV cache on standby nodes before draining. We'll also enable prefix caching for known prod tenants for 30m pre-window.
raul: Ops ask — do we need extra burst capacity reserved? If we autoscale into cloud GPUs for ~3 hours that's an extra cost. Ballpark increase ~20% for that time. Approve?
priya: Sales asked for demo SLA; they prefer no visible degradation. If we provision burst, who covers cost?
alex: For now product covers one-off burst budget. If cost goes >$X we'll notify finance. Also we'll try routing policy to prefer dedicated pools for critical tenants during the window.
sam: Playbook summary:
```
1) 01:15 UTC — seed KV/prefix cache on standby nodes
2) 01:30 — scale up burst pool (if needed)
3) 02:00 — cohort A: cordon + drain (nodes with label cohort=a)
   kubectl cordon <node>
   ./drain-node --grace 300 --skip-pvc
4) 02:30 — cohort B
5) 03:00 — cohort C
6) post-window: 05:00–05:30 rollback checks + smoke tests
```
priya: Add canary traffic split for first cohort (5% traffic) — if latency regresses >10% rollback scheduling.
raul: We'll also disable low-priority batch jobs during the window to free slots. I'll push a job-suspend policy at 01:45.
nina: Any deploy collisions? I have a model rollout queued for Tue 03:00. I can move it.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for model/embedding-service at 2025-06-10T03:00Z — collision detected with MAINT-4231. Please reschedule.
oncall-bot: Maintenance MAINT-4231 created by alex. Pager rotation: priya on-call primary, sam secondary. Notifications sent to #customers-notify.
alex: I'll draft customer comms: short notice that APAC customers may see degraded perf 02:00–05:00 UTC, but we expect no data loss and a canary rollback if SLOs dip.
priya: +1 for wording. Add a line recommending customers schedule big batch runs outside 02–06 UTC.
sam: Post-maint checks: token-level cost telemetry, tail-latency dashboards, and KV hit-rate. We'll alert if 95th p99 rises >150ms baseline.
raul: One more ask: bump backfill priority for Dedicated pools to accept overflow during cohorts so hosted API stays stable. I can update routing rules.
alex: Cool. Action items: finalize cohort node list by EOD, confirm KV seed script, create MAINT page, send customer notice 24h prior. :thumbsup:
priya: I'll own customer comms draft. sam/nina please confirm no deploys in window. :eyes:
nina: I'll move my rollout to Thu.
sam: I cancel my non-critical infra changes.
alex: Thanks all — will post final runbook + node mapping in this thread before EOD.
__notes: This file is a single Slack thread; messages are chronological and prefixed by sender name as required.
